correctness.rationale: The fifth-power identity \(F=H\circ T\) is exact over \(\mathbb Z_2\). The two triangular parity branches are isometries onto \(\mathbb Z_2\). The two unit branches of H in each even-valuation stratum have difference valuation one above the input distance, proving surjectivity and exact fibers by compactness. This yields the disjoint image, Haar measure 1/6, every finite-modulus target multiplicity and the sharp index periods; the critical factorization and boundary cases k=1,2,3 are explicitly checked in RESULT.md. The standalone checker passed 32,805 exact finite assertions for \(k\le13\); numerical tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The fifth powers are the first odd Faulhaber case after the cubic triangular-square identity, making their global local representability and fiber behavior a natural exact invariant. A full solution for all k determines previously unspecified holes, infinite shells, a sharp 1/6 density, fourfold typical branching with an exceptional zero fiber, and least input periods. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice, and the exact 5 mod 8 condition is structurally motivated by the non-square unit factor.
